'''Zardossa Stix''' was a [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] located in the [[Zardossa Stix system/Legends|Zardossa Stix system]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region. It was the site of an ancient [[Zardossa Stix Pyramid|temple]] built in honor of [[Malmourral/Legends|Malmourral]], the [[Bardottan/Legends|Bardottan]] [[Demon/Legends|demon]] of war. In [[20 BBY/Legends|19.1 BBY]], the [[Frangawl Cult/Legends|Frangawl Cult]] [[Mission to Bardotta/Legends|kidnapped]] [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Julia/Legends|Julia]] of the nearby [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bardotta/Legends|Bardotta]] and brought [[Gender/Legends|her]] to the temple, where she was to be sacrificed in order to empower [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]]. However, she was [[Mission to Zardossa Stix/Legends|rescued]] by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Junior Representative/Legends|Junior Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]].

==Descirption==
A [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]], Zardossa Stix<ref name="Episode Guide" /> Zardossa Stix was located in the [[Zardossa Stix system/Legends|Zardossa Stix system]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region,<ref name="TEAOC" /> near the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bardotta/Legends|Bardotta]].<ref name="Nexus of Power">''[[Nexus of Power]]''</ref> It [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] a single [[Star/Legends|star]] alongside two other moons. Zardossa Stix was inhabited by a variety of imported fauna, including [[Dalgo/Legends|dalgos]], [[Eopie/Legends|eopies]], [[Gundark/Legends|gundarks]], [[Tooka/Legends|tookas]].<ref name="The Disappeared" />

==History==
In the ancient past, the [[Frangawl Cult/Legends|Frangawl]], a [[Bardottan/Legends|Bardottan]] mystic cult,<ref name="Nexus of Power" /> built a [[Zardossa Stix Pyramid|stone ziggurat]] on Zardossa Stix in honor of [[Malmourral/Legends|Malmourral]], the Bardottan [[Demon/Legends|demon]] of war.<ref name="Episode Guide" />

In [[20 BBY/Legends|19.1 BBY]],<ref name="The Disappeared II Date">{{TCWdates|609}}</ref> the Frangawl Cult [[Mission to Bardotta/Legends|kidnapped]] the [[Queen/Legends|queen]] of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of Bardotta, [[Julia/Legends|Julia]], and took [[Gender/Legends|her]] to the temple on Zardossa Stix. There, they planned to extract her [[Living Force/Legends|Living Force]] energy and use it to empower the [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]], who they revered as the Great Mother. The Queen's lover, [[Junior Representative/Legends|Junior Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] [[Mission to Zardossa Stix/Legends|pursued]] the cultists to the temple, where they disurpted the ritual and saved the queen.<ref name="The Disappeared" />

==Inhabitants==
[[Unidentified Zardossa Stix city|Zardossa Stix Port]] was inhabited by members of a variety of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]], including [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]], Bardottans, [[Gossam/Legends|Gossams]], [[Gotal/Legends|Gotals]], [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorians]], [[Khramboan/Legends|Khramboans]], [[Nimbanel/Legends|Nimbanels]], [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]], [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]], [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyans]], [[Siniteen/Legends|Siniteen]], [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]], [[Weequay/Legends|Weequays]], and [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrians]]. There were also members of a [[Unidentified tentacle-faced species/Legends|tentacle-faced species]], as well as [[Voe Atell's species/Legends|those]] [[Kerch Kushi's species/Legends|of]] [[Voe Atell/Legends|Voe Atell's]] and [[Kerch Kushi/Legends|Kerch Kushi's]] species.<ref name="The Disappeared" />

==Locations==
The sole [[city]] located on Zardossa Stix was Zardossa Stix Port. At its center was a town square that featured a marketplace,<ref name="Episode Guide" /> and it was connected to the Zardossa Stix Pryamid via a [[Railspeeder|rail speeder]] track.<ref name="The Disappeared" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zardossa Stix first appeared in "[[The Disappeared, Part II]],"<ref name="The Disappeared" /> the ninth episode of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''{{'}} [[The Clone Wars: The Lost Missions|sixth season]],<ref name="Episode Guide" /> which originally aired in [[Wikipedia:Germany|Germany]] on [[March 1]], [[2014]].<ref name="German TV Schedule">{{WebCite|url=https://www.fernsehserien.de/star-wars-the-clone-wars/folgen/6x09-verschollen-teil-2-583339|text=Star Wars: The Clone Wars Staffel 6, Folge 9: Verschollen – Teil 2|work=[https://www.fernsehserien.de fernsehserian.de]|language=[[Wikipedia:German|German]]|archivedate=20210222210245}} {{C|[https://translate.google.com/translate?hl=en&sl=de&tl=en&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.fernsehserien.de%2Fstar-wars-the-clone-wars%2Ffolgen%2F6x09-verschollen-teil-2-583339&sandbox=1 English translation]}}</ref> It was first identified in the accompanying [[The Clone Wars Episode Guides|episode guide]] on [[StarWars.com]].<ref name="Episode Guide" />
